conversion_policy: Prices, sizes and timestamps are exact; nothing is rounded. Source publisher and instrument IDs are kept; the channel is the source channel_id, or 0 when the file has none. NWT sequences restart at 1 per (publisher, channel); the source sequence number is not carried. Source flags are not carried. Each instrument's definition comes from the venue's definition file and is written before its first record. Source stat_type -> NWT stat_type: 1 opening price -> 1 open; 5 session high -> 2 high; 4 session low -> 3 low; 11 close price -> 4 close; 3 settlement price -> 5 settlement; 6 cleared volume -> 7 volume; 9 open interest -> 8 open interest. Any other source type stops the conversion. update_action 1 -> SET, 2 -> DELETE. An empty ts_ref is null. On a settlement price, source stat_flags bit 0 means final: a settlement without it is written with the preliminary bit set. Any other flag value, or a flag on another type, stops the conversion. A row with no value (an empty price, or the source's null quantity) is skipped and counted.
